level: Institutional country arrangements, not complete rival codes/calibrated budgets or observed nations

common_scope.later_duties: Open continuing obligations beyond the37 rows; not silently capped
rights: equal political standing and peaceful replacement
ordinary lawful enterprise/association and voluntary community

models.title: Strong retain/repair
models.diagnosis: Inherited working arrangements may outperform a replacement programme.
models.income_and_claims: Actual inherited protected income/insurance and essential duties, repaired where deficient; no invented weak baseline.
models.provision_and_ownership: Lawful existing public/plural institutions and informal cooperation; no wholesale institutional replacement.
models.retained_power_and_failure: Inherited capture/exclusion may remain; required democratic repair is not free.
models.evidence_or_value_choice_that_could_chan: Lower transition/administrative burden with at-least-preserved rights and actually repaired exclusion.
models.constitutional_floor: Meaningful democracy, actual separate review/execution, revocable assistance; no inherited sovereignty or automatic law adoption.
models.research_status: substantive rival with incomplete detailed specification

models.title: Current service-first plural country
models.diagnosis: Actual unmet needs and concentrated dependence require personal guarantees, public responsibility and real exit.
models.income_and_claims: Individual I05/SD05 plus universal S and earned Y; rights-preserving U+C2 stays a rival.
models.provision_and_ownership: Public essential-delivery backbone with voluntary plural providers and ownership.
models.retained_power_and_failure: Means-test intrusion/nonclaim, contractor/common-node control and public fallback cost.
models.evidence_or_value_choice_that_could_chan: A simpler or differently owned arrangement offers better protected control/access and complete burdens.
models.constitutional_floor: Meaningful democracy, actual separate review/execution, revocable assistance; no inherited sovereignty or automatic law adoption.

models.title: Territorial direct-public essential-service country
models.diagnosis: Contracting/interface dependence can undermine receiving and accountability.
models.income_and_claims: Same I05/SD05/S/Y protection and old stronger rights; private ordinary enterprise remains lawful.
models.provision_and_ownership: Direct public provision in the defined service scope; voluntary additional routes and independent review remain.
models.retained_power_and_failure: Management/monopoly/patronage, paid acquisition/recruitment and practical user/worker choice.
models.evidence_or_value_choice_that_could_chan: Actual access/control/quality and paid transition justify replacing the current plural service arrangement.
models.constitutional_floor: Meaningful democracy, actual separate review/execution, revocable assistance; no inherited sovereignty or automatic law adoption.
models.research_status: substantive rival with incomplete detailed specification

models.title: Rights-preserving U+C2 country
models.diagnosis: Repeated means inquiry can undermine independence and exclude eligible people.
models.income_and_claims: Universal ordinary foundation with C2, same essential/additional needs and earned rights; no cancelled claims.
models.provision_and_ownership: Usable public/plural routes, not cash substituted for all services.
models.retained_power_and_failure: Complete extra tax/source/incidence, residual need tests, prices, rent extraction and overlap.
models.evidence_or_value_choice_that_could_chan: Actual autonomy/nonclaim/administrative gains and legitimate value choice justify complete source/transition burdens.
models.constitutional_floor: Meaningful democracy, actual separate review/execution, revocable assistance; no inherited sovereignty or automatic law adoption.
models.research_status: substantive rival with incomplete detailed specification

models.title: Decentralized mutual/common country
models.diagnosis: Situated knowledge and worker/user/community control can outperform national provider mediation.
models.income_and_claims: Same enforceable personal/essential/earned floor, national equalization and stronger old claims.
models.provision_and_ownership: Voluntary worker/user/local common provision with accountable national residual duties.
models.retained_power_and_failure: Unequal local means, informal coercion, real exit/receiving, common-source and interlocal/external obligations.
models.evidence_or_value_choice_that_could_chan: Actual voluntary control, practical exit/equality and complete paid duties improve over centralized/contracted forms.
models.constitutional_floor: Meaningful democracy, actual separate review/execution, revocable assistance; no inherited sovereignty or automatic law adoption.
models.research_status: substantive rival with incomplete detailed specification
